main.name: Swaleha
main.description: Dedicated Full Stack Developer with QA Expertise
main.bio: I am a Full Stack Developer currently working at VerifyWise in Canada, specializing in building scalable and user-friendly web applications with React, Node.js, and .NET. I have experience setting up automated testing and deployment pipelines using Playwright, Postman, and Azure DevOps. I enjoy taking projects from concept to deployment, solving real problems along the way, and ensuring clean, maintainable code. Open to new opportunities, I am passionate about delivering software that is not only functional but also impactful.

Swaleha has been a cornerstone of innovation at FlexC, playing a pivotal role in the development of the OCTO feature. Her dedication to quality, problem-solving mindset, and technical expertise have consistently exceeded expectations.
